objective: G18 with G17. Census, reduction and seeded search over structures whose distinctions may have three holders, with observer distinctions loose or already shared. Stop at the smallest structure found in each class with a lower bound from the census.
status: Exhaustive census for named classes, referee pending. If the setting birth may take a distinction already held twice, a structure of 7 knots of both laws with every old distinction held at most twice gives 19/9 with both complete records hidden, 8 and 9 knots give the ceiling 20/9, and none with 6 or fewer exists within the census bounds. With loose observer distinctions and at most three holders none was found (sides of at most 4 knots, and 5 knots with two shared distinctions: 4.03 billion pairs); the only one known is the 18-knot structure with two distinctions held four times.
title: The smallest structure with a hidden excess, and whether a third holder is enough
